summary: The example inventory for a 2.4 multi-node controller and hub upgrade to 2.6 enterprise has two [automationgateway] hosts, two [automationcontroller] hosts with peers=execution_nodes, and [execution_nodes] with one hop node and two execution nodes, followed by hub and EDA groups.
